selectionRules: Use generated shots only when they add depth, explanation, atmosphere or continuity that deterministic motion alone cannot provide efficiently.
Prefer image-to-video from an approved first frame when composition matters.
Never bake official identity, prices, routes, phone numbers, metrics or claims into generated pixels.
Never use generative video as documentary evidence or to fabricate an official vehicle, beneficiary, location or event.
A generated shot must enter the final piece under deterministic typography, factual QA and brand governance.
